content_sections.heading: CIC Registrar Recruitment 2027 - Overview

rows.central_information_commission_cic_new_d: Level-13 in the pay matrix Rs. 123100-215900 (7th CPC)

Bachelor Degree in Law from a recognised university or institute; holding an analogous post on regular basis, or five years' regular service in Level-12 (Rs.78800-209200) or equivalent. Desirable: two years' experience in legal or judicial work.

Deputy Secretary (Admn), Room No. – 508, 5th Floor, Central Information Commission, Baba Gangnath Marg, Munirka, New Delhi-110067

content_sections.heading: CIC Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. Admn-15014/4/2021-ADMN-CIC gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CIC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or Department; or officers with five years' service rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in Level-12 in the pay matrix (Rs.78800-209200) or equivalent in the Parent Cadre or Department; Essential: Bachelor Degree in Law from a recognised university or institute Experience: Desirable: Experience of two years in Legal or Judicial work Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Open to eligible officers of Central Government, State Government, Union Territory Administrations, Autonomous Bodies, Statutory Organisations, Public Sector Undertakings, Universities, Recognised Research Institutions, Court or Tribunal Desirable: Experience of two years in Legal or Judicial work

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Selected officers may draw their pay plus deputation (duty) allowance or have pay fixed in the scale/level of the post under DoPT O.M. No.2/12/87-Estt (Pay II) dated 29.04.1988, as amended from time to time. Deputation (including short-term contract) basis Period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed five years, including preceding ex-cadre deputation

content_sections.heading: How Will CIC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Applications assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection Information and documents submitted will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma (Annexure-I) duly filled in Photocopies of CRs/APARs for the last five years, each page attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the GOI Cadre clearance Vigilance clearance and integrity certificate Statement showing major or minor penalties, if any, imposed during the last ten years Latest salary slip, if the applicant's organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CIC Recruitment 2027 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma as per Annexure-I of DoP&T OM No. AB.14017/28/2014-Estt. (RR) dated 02.07.2015. Download the proforma from www.cic.gov.in. Send the application with all relevant documents to Deputy Secretary (Admn), Room No. – 508, 5th Floor, Central Information Commission, Baba Gangnath Marg, Munirka, New Delhi-110067. Write on the envelope: Application for the post of __________________ on deputation basis. Sponsoring authority to furnish CRs/APARs, cadre clearance, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate and penalty statement while forwarding. Make sure it reaches by 18 January 2027.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CIC Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CIC Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Registrar.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CIC Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma, Annexure-I of DoP&T OM No. AB.14017/28/2014-Estt. (RR) dated 02.07.2015, downloadable from www.cic.gov.in; also printed as Annexure-I in the notice) and send it to Deputy Secretary (Admn), Room No. – 508, 5th Floor, Central Information Commission, Baba Gangnath Marg, Munirka, New Delhi-110067, by by post / through proper channel, to reach by 18 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-13 in the pay matrix Rs. 123100-215900 (7th CPC).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor Degree in Law from a recognised university or institute; holding an analogous post on regular basis, or five years' regular service in Level-12 (Rs.78800-209200) or equivalent. Desirable: two years' experience in legal or judicial work.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to eligible officers of Central Government, State Government, Union Territory Administrations, Autonomous Bodies, Statutory Organisations, Public Sector Undertakings, Universities, Recognised Research Institutions, Court or Tribunal.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection. Information and documents submitted will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation (including short-term contract) basis. Period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed five years, including preceding ex-cadre deputation.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: New Delhi.
